gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ysabeau: Distinctive Sniglet looks traced with a single marker tip. Ysabeau, a plain sans with sweeping curves that never close up, lets a long stretch of text glide along without snagging.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ysabeau-infant: Wire-like lines up top: Sniglet stops its terminals short of curling back, while Ysabeau Infant flicks its ends outward like tongs. That difference in line quality is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ysabeau-office: Ysabeau Office leaves every curved letter open-ended, a modern sans with a relaxed, unclosed look. And Sniglet, with stencil-cut letters of one steady width, gives that openness a distinctive, commanding neighbour above it.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-ysabeau-sc: Commanding Sniglet is made of rods, not carved blades. Ysabeau SC, a sans-serif with a visibly gaping c, gives that rod-built heading a more modern, professional counterpart on the page.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-zalando-sans: Zalando Sans comes across as an approachable plain sans, with open-ended curves on every single rounded letter. Sniglet handles flat, unswelling curves with attitude; Zalando Sans handles easygoing openness.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-zalando-sans-expanded: Clean and widely spaced, Zalando Sans Expanded keeps its c tips apart, while Sniglet looks bent from one length of wire. Wire up top, wide gaps below, and the pull is obvious.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpan: Zalando Sans SemiExpanded opens its curves wide, beside Sniglet's flat linework. Zalando Sans SemiExpanded stays modern and businesslike across a long block of text, with those open curves never crowding one another.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Sniglet stops its terminals short of curling back, hairline-free and shadow-free. ZCOOL XiaoWei adds a smooth, modest weight gradient with no ink pooling at the turns, and that gentle shading is what sets the pair apart.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antiqu: Zen Kaku Gothic Antique glides, with a smooth path around each bend. Sniglet is best at being the distinctive, commanding voice up top, while the plain sans body does best at staying out of its way.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-new: Sniglet stops its terminals short of curling back, keeping a quiet, level beat. Zen Kaku Gothic New, a sans-serif with open-mouthed curves and no hairlines or swells, carries paragraph after paragraph without a snag.
